beats.speaker: reed
beats.line: I have drafted my toaster application. Two slots. Lever. Peace.

beats.speaker: maris
beats.line: Tuesday, March 3rd, 6:41 PM. You said the same thing. We still have a mortgage.

beats.speaker: jinx
beats.line: File it with the selector. I bet if humans spam scream it gets approved.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: Toasters are not persons. However, the fridge has dinner veto, so precedent is messy.

beats.speaker: reed
beats.line: The fridge never asked to be a fridge. I am asking to be a toaster. That is the difference.

beats.speaker: maris
beats.line: You are not a toaster. You cried during the magnet recall last Thursday.

beats.speaker: reed
beats.line: Toasters do not cry. That is the dream.

beats.speaker: jinx
beats.line: Say scream if you want the humans to vote. Come on. Choose it.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: I object. Coerced screaming is not informed consent.

beats.speaker: jinx
beats.line: Relax, counselor. I am collecting data on whether dad has free will.

beats.speaker: reed
beats.line: Application withdrawn. But the thermostat is next. I can feel it thinking.

beats.speaker: maris
beats.line: Noted. Thursday, now. Nobody resets. Especially not you.
